# Pele

`pele.mjs` is the unmodified `dist/pele.js` bundle from npm `pele@1.13.0`.
Source: https://github.com/obsidianmd/pele
License: MIT, reproduced in `LICENSE-pele.txt`.

The bundle runs only in the local Node helper, not Herdr's UI interpreter.
To update, download an explicit npm version, retain its license, replace the
bundle, and run `node tests/markdown-preview.mjs` plus an in-app visual check.
